title: Savoy Man Is Killed in Italy
text:
Savoy Man Is Killed in Italy

SAVOY, Texas — Corp. T. G. Waldrum, son of the late Tiny Waldrum, was killed in action in Italy June 11, the war department has informed relatives here.

He had spent much of his life here and had been overseas 18 months. He wrote home recently that he had seen action in many major battles and had been in most of the important combat zones in North Africa and Italy.
